Aggregate these voxel-level predictions to form 3D OBB proposals, similar to an anchor-free RPN mechanism [S1].

The claim states that voxel-level predictions are aggregated to form 3D OBB proposals, similar to an anchor-free RPN mechanism. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states that the task involves predicting 3D OBBs by regressing bounding box offsets, objectness scores, and probabilities for each voxel, and confirms that 'The task is similar to anchor-free RPN from [22].' Since the evidence confirms the method (voxel-level prediction of OBB parameters) and the comparison (similar to anchor-free RPN), the claim is fully supported.
